# Centro Containers

Centro Containers is a China-based OEM supplier and manufacturer of ISO shipping container spare parts.

Main products:
- Corner casting
- Corner post
- Cross member
- Roof panel
- Side panel
- Door panel
- Door gasket
- Door locking gear
- Bridge fitting

Centro Containers supplies B2B buyers including container manufacturers, repair depots, leasing companies and spare parts distributors.
